scene_target: Rhea analyzes the combat logs and forces Unit 734 to interface with the tollbooth terminal to trace the overseer's ledger.
goal: Trace the origin of the debt hounds by interfacing with the tollbooth's dead terminal.
conflict: Rhea is severely exhausted (1 Stamina) and must force a hijacked, damaged Unit 734 to interface with hostile System architecture.
end_condition: Rhea discovers the localized administrative hub funding the hounds, realizing the overseer has a finite budget.
transition_in_text: With the debuff timer expired and the hounds temporarily de-rezzed, Rhea turns her attention to the tollbooth's dead terminal.
transition_out_text: Rhea realizes the overseer's budget is finite and prepares to pinpoint the exact coordinates as pressure mounts outside.

persona_updates: Rhea realizes the overseer's harassment is bound by a finite mana budget, giving her a tactical target.
Vance holds the door, surviving on a sliver of HP while Rhea works the terminal.
Unit 734 is forced to interface with the dead tollbooth terminal, exposing its systems to further strain.

chapter_so_far_add: Inside the tollbooth, Rhea forced Unit 734 to interface with a dead terminal, discovering the overseer's finite mana budget and the coordinates to his administrative hub.
key_events: Rhea accessed the tollbooth's dead terminal using Unit 734's interface cable.
She analyzed the combat logs, confirming the Debt Collectors were administrative constructs costing Node Mana.
She accessed the Mana Ledger, proving the overseer had a finite budget for his targeted harassment.
Rhea acquired the coordinates for the local administrative hub funding the attacks.
last_scene: Rhea ripped the casing off the ruined tollbooth's dead terminal.
She forced Unit 734 to interface with the exposed wiring to bypass the local firewall.
Reviewing the combat logs and mana ledger, she discovered the overseer was funding the Debt Collectors from a finite local budget.
Rhea pinpointed the coordinates of the administrative hub just as the hounds began to respawn outside.
